messages.text:
The iPhone is yours now: I reserved it for you for 30 min, so no agent test will start on it.
- Nothing was running on it; the next robot-finger test (g0.0l) waits until you are done.
- When you finish, reply "done" here and I release it; after 30 min it frees itself.
What you need to do: use the iPhone; reply "done" when finished.

Released: the iPhone is free for the agents again.
What you need to do: nothing.
